quarterly_data.quarter: Planet Labs press release: Planet Launches Pelican-12 Satellite (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planet launched Pelican-12 aboard SpaceX's Bandwagon-5 rideshare from Cape Canaveral, made initial contact and began commissioning and lowering its orbit; it is Planet's 25th satellite sent to orbit in 2026, across four launches. Pelican-12 carries a prototype communication package to test satellite-to-satellite communications for SES Space & Defense by downlinking imagery via SES's O3b mPOWER satellites (a technology demonstration exploring commercial data relay), and the NVIDIA Jetson platform for on-orbit AI inferencing. Pelican production at the expanded Berlin facility is scheduled to start this year, with additional Pelican launches planned for 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 25th satellite to orbit in 2026, across four launches
